notes.title: Stephanie Lobdell walks on stage talks about preparing for the sermon. Also reads Psalm 25:2-10
notes.content: ^^@24:23^^O my God, In you I trust; do not let me be shame; do not let my enemies exult over me. Do not let those who wait for you be put to shame; let them be ashamed who are wantonly treacherous. Make me to know your ways, O Lord; teach me your paths. Lead me in your truth, and teach me, for you are the God of my salvations; for you I wait all day long. Be mindful of your mercy, O Lord, and of your steadfast love, for they have been from of old. Do not remember the sins of my youth or my transgressions; according to your steadfast love remember me, for your goodness' sake, O Lord! Good and upright is the Lord; therefore he instructs sinners in the way. He leads the humble in what is right, and teachers the humble his way. All the paths of the Lord are steadfast love and faithfulness, for those who keep his covenant and his decrees.

notes.content:
@52:18 The tent of meeting was a place that Moses and God would meet face to face. Some of the women kept mirrors from Egypt. They were a symbol of pagan worship and a symbol of self centeredness.

Me may not have mirrors but our phones are exactly the same thing, The women realized that if they wanted to serve God faithfully they would have to give up the mirrors

notes.title: Exodus 38:8
notes.content: They made the bronze basin and its bronze stand from the mirrors of the women who served the entrance to the tent of meeting.
